title: "AutoSite tutorials"

| Tutorial | You will learn to |
|---|---|
| [Small-molecule binding site identification](tutorial-small-molecule.qmd) (PDB 1STP) | run AutoSite on a macromolecule, find and understand its output files |

**Before you start:**

- [Download and install ADFRsuite 1.0](download.qmd).
- Put `ADFRsuite-1.0/bin` on your `PATH` (Linux or macOS shell).
- Download and unpack the [tutorial data](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/autosite-tutorials/1STP.tgz)
  (`1STP.tgz`).
